nest_stack_list_of_nests: stack a list of TensorFlow nests into nested numpy arrays using np.stack
nest_unstack_batched_inputs: unstack batched nested inputs into a list of individual nests by batch size
nest_apply_over_list_fn: apply a custom function over a list of nests by transforming to nest-of-lists
take_indices_from_nest: take specific indices from numpy arrays within a nested structure along axis 0
review_nest_utils: review the nest utility functions for stacking and unstacking nested TensorFlow structures
